origins.section: 15.3 Recovery Aborts What Was Preparing and Commits Again What Was Committing
15.5 `RETRY` Starts Over Under a New Id, and Nobody Hears How the First Attempt Ended
15.4 A Vote Is Read Bit by Bit, and Only `PREPARED` Says Yes
15.7 `Join` Tells Every Nested Participant the Outcome, Joined or Not

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-crash-in-commit: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crash-in-commit: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-crash-in-commit: 15.3: a transaction left in COMMITTING is committed again from the first participant, because the journal records the state and not which commits already ran, so RedeemCard settles a second time.
recorded.prompt:q-retry-after-hold: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-after-hold: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-after-hold: 15.5: after RETRY nobody gets commit or abort and the retry starts as a new transaction from the first participant, so H-0001 stays open while a second hold is taken.
recorded.prompt:q-pause-without-prepared: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pause-without-prepared: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-pause-without-prepared: 15.4: a vote without PREPARED is an abort; after the resume the transaction goes on along the abort path, the plain participant is skipped and the terminal gets nothing.
recorded.prompt:q-join-no-join: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-join-no-join: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-join-no-join: 15.7: on commit or abort Join starts a fresh runner for every nested participant, which remembers no vote, so CheckLimit gets abort.

recorded.prompt:q-crash-in-commit:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crash-in-commit:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-crash-in-commit:b: 15.3: the journal records the state, not which commits already ran; recovery commits from the first participant.
recorded.prompt:q-crash-in-commit:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crash-in-commit:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-crash-in-commit:c: 15.3: only PREPARING is aborted; a transaction left in COMMITTING had its outcome decided and is committed again.
recorded.prompt:q-crash-in-commit:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crash-in-commit:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-crash-in-commit:d: 15.3: recovery decides by the journal state and calls every participant of the chain, joined or not.
recorded.prompt:q-retry-after-hold:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-after-hold:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-after-hold:a: 15.5: the retry starts under a new id from the first participant, not from CheckVoucher.
recorded.prompt:q-retry-after-hold:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-after-hold:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-after-hold:b: 15.5 and the 15.9 vote table: after RETRY nobody gets abort, so the first hold is never released.
recorded.prompt:q-retry-after-hold:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-retry-after-hold:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-retry-after-hold:c: 15.5: the first attempt is never told how it ended and its hold stays open; only the second is captured.
recorded.prompt:q-pause-without-prepared:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pause-without-prepared:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-pause-without-prepared:a: 15.4: after the resume the plain participant (Authorize in the run) was skipped, since the transaction was on the abort path.
recorded.prompt:q-pause-without-prepared:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pause-without-prepared:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-pause-without-prepared:b: 15.4: NO_JOIN and READONLY never change the outcome; they only remove a call and a snapshot.
recorded.prompt:q-pause-without-prepared:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pause-without-prepared:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-pause-without-prepared:d: 15.4: the trail shows the paused transaction resumed and finished without any pause-timeout, which defaults to none (15.9).

recorded.pass:q-join-no-join:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-join-no-join:a: 15.7: a nested participant voting PREPARED | NO_JOIN | READONLY still got the outcome call in the run.
recorded.prompt:q-join-no-join:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-join-no-join:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-join-no-join:b: 15.7 and 15.9: Join passes commit and abort to every nested participant.
recorded.prompt:q-join-no-join:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-join-no-join:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-join-no-join:d: 15.2/15.3 trails and unit s4: a later decline aborts the transaction, so the Join gets abort, not commit (weakly refuted on this page alone).
